params.name: steps

default.title: Upload
default.say: Upload the client's Excel for the year - xls, xlsx or csv, Tally exports included. The file is kept exactly as uploaded.

default.title: Map rows
default.say: Map rows lists every row with a figure. A ref saved by a person wins, then the file's own SF Ref column, then a suggestion from the rules - shown, never applied until you accept it.

default.title: Accept and fix
default.say: Accept all suggestions takes every suggestion at once; type over any ref and press Save refs. A ref that is not 3CD, ITR3 or ITR5 with a real clause or schedule is refused, naming why.

default.title: Back to the client
default.say: Excel with SF Ref downloads the workbook with the column filled. Send it to the client: next year's file arrives already tagged.

params.label: The steps in order: title, say (the narration), target (where the spotlight goes; alternatives split by |, the first on screen wins), art (the picture: hero/flow/roads/meter/stack/check), place (below/above/right/left/center, optional), open (optional: what the guide presses first when the part is not on screen - open the first item, go back Home; alternatives split by |)
